            hits = [(pos, m) for pos, m in hits if pos >= 0]

                del self.buf[:end]

        """Read until the server is quiet for `idle` seconds or EOF/hard limit."""
        deadline = time.monotonic() + hard_limit
        out = bytearray(self.take_buffered())
        while time.monotonic() < deadline:
            slice_deadline = min(deadline, time.monotonic() + idle)
            got_data = False
            while self._fill(slice_deadline):
                got_data = True
            out.extend(self.take_buffered())
            if not got_data:
                break

    def sendline(self, text):
        self.sock.sendall(text.encode("utf-8") + b"\n")
